matrix_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-A - Market-Data Provider Due Diligence Matrix
matrix_metadata.purpose: Comprehensive institutional due diligence of candidate market-data providers for forward paper evaluation

authorized_universe_coverage_check.asset_class: US Equities & Regulated ETFs listed on NASDAQ / NYSE Arca

coverage.universe_support: VERIFIED (Full coverage of all 24 tickers including QLD and SSO)
coverage.daily_ohlcv: VERIFIED (Provides Open, High, Low, Close, Volume for all US equities/ETFs)
coverage.timestamp_semantics: VERIFIED (Official market close 16:00:00 EST / 20:00:00 or 21:00:00 UTC depending on DST; EOD delivered by 17:30 EST)
coverage.corporate_actions: VERIFIED (Explicit divCash, splitFactor, adjOpen, adjClose fields returned with daily bars)
coverage.data_adjustment_conventions: VERIFIED (Provides both raw unadjusted and corporate-action-adjusted series side by side)

contractual_and_legal_rights.internal_research_rights: VERIFIED (Terms explicitly authorize private quantitative modeling, strategy backtesting, and internal simulation)
contractual_and_legal_rights.local_storage_and_caching: VERIFIED (Permits local caching on subscriber's private disk for subscriber's own analytical workflows)
contractual_and_legal_rights.derived_data_rights: VERIFIED (Proprietary weight vectors, signals, and simulated execution logs belong entirely to subscriber)
contractual_and_legal_rights.automated_research_usage: VERIFIED (REST API designed for programmatic script execution and scheduled cron ingestion)
contractual_and_legal_rights.redistribution_restrictions: RESTRICTED (Public commercial redistribution, reselling, or public display of raw vendor price ticks is strictly prohibited; personal private use is permitted)
contractual_and_legal_rights.evidence_retention: VERIFIED (Audit logs containing derived simulation metrics and anonymized price points may be retained indefinitely)

technical_and_operational_specifications.rate_limits: 500 requests/hour, 20,000 requests/day, 50 concurrent connections (Ample for daily batch of 24 tickers)
technical_and_operational_specifications.credential_type: API Token (Bearer / Header format: Authorization: Token <api_key>)
technical_and_operational_specifications.india_account_eligibility: VERIFIED (Global credit/debit card billing supported; Indian resident individual subscriptions widely permitted without local broker entity)
technical_and_operational_specifications.outage_and_revocation_policy: VERIFIED (Standard SaaS SLA; cached historical states remain valid work product on termination)

providers.commercial_entity: Polygon.io, Inc. / Massive Data Inc. (Atlanta, GA, USA)

coverage.universe_support: VERIFIED (Complete US equity tape coverage including leveraged ETFs QLD, SSO)
coverage.timestamp_semantics: VERIFIED (Millisecond Unix timestamps; unambiguous UTC alignment)
coverage.corporate_actions: VERIFIED (Dedicated reference endpoints for splits and dividends: /v3/reference/splits, /v3/reference/dividends)

contractual_and_legal_rights.internal_research_rights: VERIFIED (Personal and commercial internal development permitted under standard developer terms)
contractual_and_legal_rights.local_storage_and_caching: VERIFIED (Temporary and persistent internal caching for analytics permitted)
contractual_and_legal_rights.derived_data_rights: VERIFIED (Derived analytical signals and performance metrics freely retainable)
contractual_and_legal_rights.redistribution_restrictions: RESTRICTED (No raw price tape rebroadcast without enterprise redistribution addendum)

technical_and_operational_specifications.rate_limits: 5 calls/min on free tier; unlimited calls/min on paid Starter tier
technical_and_operational_specifications.credential_type: API Key (query parameter apiKey=<key> or header Authorization: Bearer <key>)
technical_and_operational_specifications.india_account_eligibility: VERIFIED (International card processing via Stripe supported)
technical_and_operational_specifications.outage_and_revocation_policy: VERIFIED (High availability cloud infrastructure; status page public)

providers.commercial_entity: Alpaca Securities LLC / AlpacaDB, Inc. (San Mateo, CA, USA)
providers.evaluated_tier: Free Brokerage Account / Paper Trading Endpoint ($0/month)

coverage.universe_support: VERIFIED (All 24 tickers tradeable in paper brokerage simulator)
coverage.daily_ohlcv: VERIFIED (Alpaca Market Data API v2 provides daily bars from IEX / SIP)
coverage.corporate_actions: VERIFIED (Handled natively by paper broker ledger; cash dividends credited to account)
coverage.data_adjustment_conventions: VERIFIED (Standard SIP raw and adjusted feed)

contractual_and_legal_rights.internal_research_rights: VERIFIED (Explicitly created for paper evaluation, strategy backtesting, and automated model testing)
contractual_and_legal_rights.local_storage_and_caching: VERIFIED (Paper execution fills and portfolio account states belong to user)
contractual_and_legal_rights.derived_data_rights: VERIFIED (Full ownership of generated trading signals)
contractual_and_legal_rights.automated_research_usage: VERIFIED (Python SDK and REST API built specifically for algorithmic trading)
contractual_and_legal_rights.redistribution_restrictions: RESTRICTED (Paper trading data is for internal simulation only)
contractual_and_legal_rights.evidence_retention: VERIFIED (Execution logs and order IDs retainable indefinitely)

technical_and_operational_specifications.rate_limits: 200 calls/min across market data and trading endpoints
technical_and_operational_specifications.india_account_eligibility: CONDITIONAL (Indian residents can open Alpaca brokerage accounts, but requires passport KYC and LRS compliance for live funding; paper-only accounts may be restricted depending on regional regulatory onboarding rules)
technical_and_operational_specifications.outage_and_revocation_policy: VERIFIED (Maintenance windows announced; paper environment isolated from live clearing)

coverage.universe_support: VERIFIED (Universal coverage of all US equities, sector ETFs, and leveraged ETFs)

coverage.data_adjustment_conventions: VERIFIED (Adjusted for splits and dividends or unadjusted options)

contractual_and_legal_rights.local_storage_and_caching: VERIFIED (Account logs stored locally on user machine)

human_decision_requirements.description: Owner must select either a Data-Only API (Tiingo or Polygon) paired with local causal simulator, or a Broker-Paper API (Alpaca or IBKR).
human_decision_requirements.default_recommendation: Tiingo EOD Personal API for local air-gapped evaluation due to clean corporate action handling and simplicity of EOD daily batch execution.
